description: This file defines an abstract class `HttpSpecializedException` within the Slim framework's exception handling system. It extends `HttpException` and adds a constructor that requires an HTTP request object and optionally a message and previous exception, primarily for specialized HTTP exception handling.

classes.name: HttpSpecializedException
classes.description: An abstract class that extends HttpException to provide specialized HTTP exception handling with access to the HTTP request object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the HTTP request, optional message, and optional previous exception.
